nodes.label: Free bike
nodes.summary: Modal → CLAIM YOUR BIKE → LET'S GO; bike in garage as STARTER Free.
nodes.detail: Claimed on QA 2026-10-26 [Observed]. Modal rules: 7 claims; 4–20% of rate; 1 use/claim; rests 36h; cannot repair; car parks bike for good. Post-claim: CTA becomes LET'S GO + “The bike is in your wallet.” Garage: OVR 5; OCTANE 1.0; SPEED 19.2; DURABILITY/SECURITY/LUCK 1.0; copy “The free bike: a 24-hour wait…” (conflicts with modal 36h) [Observed]. No reclaim CTA after grant.
tcIdeas: Claim modal appears when eligible (no car)
Modal rules match live copy (7 / 4–20% / 36h / no repair / car parks bike)
CLAIM YOUR BIKE grants bike ownership / garage entry
Post-claim LET'S GO dismisses and leaves bike equipped
Garage rest copy matches modal rest period
Decline or dismiss path (if any) leaves account without bike and re-offers later
